The '''South Work Yard''' was part of [[Jenith]]'s [[Jenith Spaceport|spaceport]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. During the [[Raid on Chelloa]], [[Gorlan Palladane]] and his fellow workers were working there. They were about to be executed by a squad of [[Daimanate Sith trooper]]s when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] intervened and immobilized the attackers. The South Work Yard survived the damage inflicted by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s [[kinetic corruptor]].
